objective: Auditar en modo solo lectura el estado actual de Tablajeria legacy Cienfuegos y MPRO y su posible mapeo hacia EDARSAHUB como fuente canonica final. No modificar base de datos, no ejecutar migraciones, no crear tablas, no crear endpoints, no crear UI y no convertir bases legadas en fuente canonica.

queries.name: database_names_discovery
queries.sql: SELECT name AS database_name, database_id, create_date, state_desc, compatibility_level FROM sys.databases WHERE name IN ('Tablajeria','tablajeria_mpro','EDARSAHUB') OR name LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR name LIKE '%tablaj%' OR name LIKE '%EDARSA%' ORDER BY name

queries.name: current_database_context
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS current_database, SYSTEM_USER AS system_user_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user_name, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name

queries.name: current_db_tablajeria_related_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR o.name LIKE '%tablaj%' OR o.name LIKE '%Transform%' OR o.name LIKE '%Produccion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Merma%' OR o.name LIKE '%Rendimiento%' ORDER BY s.name, o.name

queries.name: current_db_inventory_related_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR o.name LIKE '%Kardex%' OR o.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR o.name LIKE '%Insumo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Movimiento%' OR o.name LIKE '%Costo%' ORDER BY s.name, o.name

queries.name: current_db_rbac_audit_workflow_accounting_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR o.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR o.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR o.name LIKE '%RBAC%' OR o.name LIKE '%Auditoria%' OR o.name LIKE '%Workflow%' OR o.name LIKE '%Evento%' OR o.name LIKE '%Contab%' ORDER BY s.name, o.name
